column1: # CloudFront flat-rate pricing plans, per distribution and apex domain, USD per month.
# A plan bundles the CDN, AWS WAF and DDoS protection, Route 53 DNS, the TLS certificate,
# edge compute and S3 storage credits. CloudWatch Logs ingestion for access logs comes
# with the plans that include access logs. No overage charges; sustained use above the
# allowance may slow delivery. Requests blocked by WAF do not count against the allowance.
# Accounts on the AWS Free Tier plan cannot subscribe.
# Feature columns (yes/no) are matched by plan_needs_<column> rows in a usage profile.
# Columns (TAB-separated): plan, usd, requests, data_gb, s3_credit_gb, access_logs,
